section.title: MCP external tools
section.subtitle: Connect MCP servers and hand their tools to the model
field.servers.label: Server list (one line of JSON)
field.servers.help: An array, one server per entry. For stdio give name + command (+ args/cwd/env); for http give name + transport:"http" + url (+ headers). Names in env are passed to the child process as they are; leave a value empty to take the same name from the host environment. To set one tool's risk level on its own, add "risk":{"tool name":"read"}; the server-wide default is "defaultRisk". The whole list is validated on save.
field.defaultRisk.label: Risk level for servers without defaultRisk
field.defaultRisk.option.exec: exec: asks for approval every time (recommended)
field.defaultRisk.option.write: write: asks for approval on writes
field.defaultRisk.option.read: read: let it through (only for servers you know are read-only)
field.defaultRisk.help: MCP tools are programs from outside; err on the safe side when you are not sure what one will do.
field.callTimeoutMs.label: Timeout per call (ms)
field.connectTimeoutMs.label: Handshake timeout (ms)
field.reconnect.label: Reconnect automatically after a drop
field.reconnectInitialDelayMs.label: First reconnect wait (ms)
field.reconnectMaxDelayMs.label: Longest reconnect wait (ms)
field.reconnectMaxAttempts.label: Give up after this many failures
field.reload.label: Reconnect all servers
field.reload.help: Drops the current connections and connects again; the status is on the next line.
field.status.label: Current status
